title: Keep a token out of the image
statement: A build needs a private registry token for `npm ci`, and the token must not be recoverable from the final image (layers or history). Pick every one that applies.
choices: Use `RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc,target=/root/.npmrc npm ci` and build with `--secret id=npmrc,src=$HOME/.npmrc`
Run `npm ci` in a builder stage of a multi-stage build and COPY only node_modules and the app into a final stage that never sees the token
Set ENV NPM_TOKEN=... then `RUN npm ci && unset NPM_TOKEN`
